title: langchain-typesafe==0.1.0
description: langchain-typesafe 0.1.0 drops support for Python 3.10 , which has reached end-of-life. The minimum supported version is now Python 3.11, and the minimum langchain-core version is now 1.8.0 ( langchain 1.5.0 for the experimental extra). Users on Python 3.10 will continue to resolve langchain-typesafe 0.0.x.
